info.title: Bahasha API v1
info.description: Member mobile API for Bahasha church contributions and account services.

get.description: Verify database access and report API readiness and version.

post.description: Authenticate an approved member and issue a device-bound token pair.
Rotate a valid refresh token and invalidate its predecessor.
Revoke the presented API session while remaining safe to repeat.
Send recovery mail without revealing whether an account exists.

get.description: Return the authenticated member's current profile.

patch.description: Update permitted self-service profile fields and create an audit event.

get.description: Return the authenticated member's private profile photo.

post.description: Validate and replace the authenticated member's profile photo.

delete.description: Remove the authenticated member's profile photo idempotently.

get.description: Assemble the member dashboard, active period, cards, and capabilities.
Return configurable category cards for the selected financial year.
Return one member-scoped category card and its calculated summary.
Return paid, missing, and upcoming weeks for one weekly category.
List financial years belonging to the authenticated member's church.
Return cursor-paginated annual targets owned by the member.
Return filtered contribution history scoped to member and church.
Return one contribution only when it belongs to the authenticated member.
Return cursor-paginated notifications with per-member read state.

post.description: Mark one visible notification read using an idempotent receipt update.
Register or rotate a push token for one app installation.

delete.description: Deactivate a member-owned device registration idempotently.

get.description: List providers available under the enabled payment mode.

post.description: Create an idempotent intent and request a mobile-money prompt.

get.description: Return recent member-owned payment requests and their current states.
Poll payment state and reconcile the deterministic mock provider.

post.description: Cancel a member-owned intent while it is still awaiting authorization.
